versions.changelog:
Initial release of himalaya-tool, a CLI to manage emails and access 50+ AI/ML models via SkillBoss API.

- Manage emails using IMAP/SMTP: list, read, write, reply, and search.
- Access 50+ models for image/video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, web search, and document parsing.
- Includes detailed bash usage examples for each model type.
- Smart routing available to auto-select the cheapest or highest-quality model for a task.
- Authentication via SKILLBOSS_API_KEY.
